answer.rationale: Renew the incumbent to avoid an unbuffered supply interruption 14 days before expiry. The incumbent has refused price reopening, so this will not satisfy the 18% component-spend mandate on its own; however, a primary switch at 94% line utilization has material downstream downtime risk. Verify memory_c2 because the documented cost-saving switch is the only credible near-term alternative, but its record must establish delivery reliability and transition performance, not merely low price and accurate invoicing.
